transcript.content: Hi, I'm trying to sort out my post-graduation work permit. It expires in a few months and I honestly don't know what I'm supposed to do next.
Happy to help. When exactly does the permit expire?
Early next spring, so about four months from now. I've been working full time since I graduated, if that matters.
It does. Have you had any previous applications or interactions with IRCC?
Umm, yeah. I had a visitor visa refused in 2024. I wasn't sure whether that was relevant, so I hadn't brought it up.
Thanks for telling me. Do you have family in Canada, or a partner?
Yes, my partner and I have lived together for a bit over two years. He has a Brazilian passport, if that changes anything.
It might open a second route. Let me see who on our side handles common-law files.
Okay. Roughly how long does something like this usually take? I'm a bit anxious about the timing.
Typically a few weeks to get started. I'm checking availability now.
That's a relief. I'd rather get moving before the permit gets any closer to expiring.
lawyer matched for QC immigration with common-law representation.
